page_notes.422: 5-56 Double Arm Narrow Mesh Retainer with Narrow Backing Plates: 2518/2518-Black (15, RT) extracted with suggested T-slot and backing-plate hardware; 10 and metric rows skipped; 3960 (RT only) noted.
page_notes.423: 5-57 Double Arm Wide Mesh Retainer with Wide Backing Plates: 2520/2520-Black (15, RT) extracted with suggested hardware; 10 and metric rows skipped; 3960 (RT only) noted.
page_notes.424: 5-58 Tabletop Fastening Kit 2810/2810-Black (15) and Roll-in Mesh Panel Retainer 2442 (15/40) extracted; 2811/2811-Black (RT only) and 65-2810 (metric) skipped.
page_notes.426: 5-60 Economy Sliding Door Glide 2068 and Standard Sliding Door Glide 2051 (15) extracted; 10 and metric rows skipped; Required Machining Services table (End Tap) has no service number or 15 badge, so it is recorded in notes only.
page_notes.427: 5-61 Standard Sliding Door Glide Profile 6808 and 6808-145 (15) extracted, UHMW material specs applied; 10 and metric rows skipped; Cut to Length requirement (ref 11-2) noted.
page_notes.428: 5-62 Upper & Lower Door Slide Track: 2210 family (Upper Door) and 2220 family (Lower Door) 15-series rows extracted; 10 and metric rows skipped; Cut to Length requirement (ref 11-2) noted.
page_notes.429: 5-63 Wheel Bracket 4445 (15) extracted with suggested 3118 profile-end bolts and End Tap requirement; 4043 (10/25) and 40-4445 (metric) skipped.
page_notes.430: 5-64 Roller Wheel with Ball Bearing Hub 12017 and 12020 (15/40) extracted; 12018, 12021 (45 metric), 12024 Roller Wheel with Steel Hub (10/25) and 12022 Reinforced Roller Wheel (45) skipped.

remaining_doubts: 5-62: the note 'For panel height subtract .500” from overall height' is printed between the upper and lower track drawings in each column; it was applied to both the 2210 (upper) and 2220 (lower) families, but it may refer only to the upper track or to the upper/lower pair.

5-60: the Required Machining Services table (End Tap, Mounting Profile, ref 11-3) is printed below the Standard Sliding Door Glide table; it is attached to 2051 and only mentioned as uncertain for 2068 Economy Sliding Door Glide.
5-62: 2220-Black weight is printed as .0226 lb / in. while 2220 (clear) is .022 lb / in.; both kept verbatim.
No machining_service parts were created: the Required Machining Services tables on 5-60, 5-61, 5-62 and 5-63 carry no service numbers and no series badge.
3960 (RT only) Ready Tube mounting bolt assembly on 5-56/5-57 kept in notes rather than suggested_hardware, since only 15/F rows are attached.
